shopify.title: Alder bucket bag
shopify.descriptionHtml:
Alder pairs a tall bucket silhouette with softly textured leather and a simple turn-lock detail. A top handle and longer strap keep the shape adaptable, while internal pockets give small essentials a place.

  • Bucket silhouette with top handle
  • Long shoulder strap
  • Internal phone pocket and zippered compartment

specifications.care: General guidance for the leather exterior, not product-specific manufacturer instructions. Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight, heaters and damp storage. If wet, let the leather dry naturally away from heat. Do not machine wash or use household cleaners. Identify the finish before using a treatment; use only a suitable product and test an unseen area first. For stains or an unknown finish, consult a leather-care specialist.
